android.desc:
🎵 TAMIL CHAT — More Than Just Chatting

The only Tamil app where you can chat, call, 
host your own group AND watch YouTube together 
with Tamils worldwide!

🎬 WATCH YOUTUBE TOGETHER
Watch any YouTube video in sync with your Tamil 
friends — pause, play, and react together in 
real time. No other Tamil chat app does this!

🎙️ GROUP MIC — LIVE AUDIO ROOMS
Jump into live Tamil voice rooms. Talk, listen 
and vibe — like a live show where YOU are 
the host!

💬 CHAT FEATURES
📞 Private voice calling — call anyone free
👥 Create your own groups and invite members
🗣️ Tamil and English group chat rooms
🔒 Private one-to-one messaging
😂 GIFs, emoji reactions and stickers
📸 Share photos and videos
🎲 Random chat — meet new Tamils instantly
🔔 Real-time notifications

👥 PERFECT FOR
Tamil people looking to make new friends, 
Sri Lankan Tamils connecting worldwide, 
Malaysian and Singaporean Tamil community, 
NRI Tamils staying connected from abroad, 
and anyone who loves Tamil language and culture.

🌍 CONNECT FROM ANYWHERE
India — Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Salem, 
Tiruchirappalli, Tirunelveli, Vellore, 
Erode, Thanjavur, Trichy

Worldwide — Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Singapore, 
UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman,
UK, USA, Canada, Australia

🔥 WHY TAMIL CHAT?
Watch YouTube Together — the only Tamil app 
with this feature! Live Group Mic audio rooms, 
create and manage your own groups, active Tamil 
community 24/7, safe and moderated environment, 
trusted by Tamils worldwide.

Also available on web at PocketChats.com
Also try Mallu Chat by Newton Labz on Google Play
